title: Multi agent retrieval validation and knowledge reasoning for enhanced retrieval augmented generation
mechanism: Add a validator agent stage after recall that cross-checks each retrieved memory/triplet against the query using a lightweight entailment/consistency check before it enters the RRF-merged context, plus a lightweight multi-hop reasoning pass over retrieved triplets before answer synthesis

expected_gain.rationale: chitta already does multi-lane RRF + optional cross-encoder rerank (chitta-mcp/server.py handle_recall_gateway) but has no post-retrieval validation/entailment-filter agent or explicit multi-hop reasoning stage over triplets before synthesis, so this fills a distinct gap rather than duplicating rerank

cost.scope: chitta-mcp/server.py recall gateway, new validator module, adds LLM call latency to hot recall path

evidence.claim: Citation check 2026-09-16: the fetched publisher abstract describes MARCO as four cooperative agents: Retriever, Reasoner, Validator and Synthesizer.

Citation check 2026-09-16: the publisher text describes cross-source consistency assessment and confidence-based filtering by the Validator, coordinated through a Shared Memory Pool and communication protocol; this does not verify the proposed gain for chitta.
